name: Makai Dokis! Disgaea
source:
A fan-made visual novel that takes place in the world of Disgaea 4. You play as an Unprinny who was sent to Hades after a tragic car accident. Your mission is to find love!

[Edited from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=24561]Lemma Soft[/url]]
translation:
一部由粉丝制作的视觉小说，故事发生在《魔界战记4》的世界中。你扮演一名在一场悲惨车祸后被送往哈迪斯的Unprinny。你的任务是寻找爱情！

[编辑自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=24561]Lemma Soft[/url]]
